description: Start a job to make a 3D model from one of the user's own pictures (image_id) or from a description (prompt), with Meshy6, Meshy V7, Meshy V7.1, Rodin v2.5, Trellis 2, Tripo P2, Tripo Parts. Tripo Parts makes a model in separate parts from a picture. Prices depend on the model and its options: Tripo Parts 115 Gold, Tripo P2 115 to 150 Gold; chargen_list_media_models with kind model_3d lists every model's price and options. First call chargen_quote_3d_model, confirm the price with the user, then supply its quote_token with identical inputs. Spends the quoted Gold; returns request_id to poll with chargen_get_job, which gives the model file (media_url, model_format) when it is done. Improve the result with the 3D tools, for example chargen_quote_3d_cleanup. An identical call within about 10 minutes returns the earlier request instead of charging again; pass a new idempotency_key when the user wants another take with the same settings.

hint.description: Tripo Parts only: optional guidance for how to split the parts.

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry key (letters, numbers, - and _). Reusing it returns the same request without a new charge; a new key makes a new take with the same settings.

image_id.description: One of the user's own still pictures (from chargen_search_gallery) to make the model from. Give image_id or prompt, not both. Required for Meshy V7, Trellis 2 and Tripo Parts.

options.description: Optional model settings by their exact key, for example {"Texture Quality": "detailed"} for Tripo P2. chargen_list_media_models with kind model_3d lists each model's keys and values; any other key is refused.

prompt.description: A description of the model, for a model that makes models from text. Leave it out when image_id is given.

quote_token.description: Approved quote_token from chargen_quote_3d_model. Use the same inputs; changed inputs or prices fail without charging.

name: chargen_generate_3d_model
title: Create 3D model
